description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rate of Exchange effective from 09.07.2018
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It exercises regulatory authority under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), which falls under legal/regulatory matters. The notification rescinds previous rates and establishes new ones through statutory authority, making it a regulatory instrument rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized matter.
